source: [The air dances in a haze over the polished, black hood of the car. You presume it's even warmer inside, as the windows and doors seem to be locked.]
[Inside, you can spot a box of pastries. You're unsure what they are, but you know that the heat inside must be unbearable by now. You probably shouldn't eat those.]
[Nothing of the sort, barring a packet of cigarettes that has been sat on, and a crumpled brown bag stained with condiments and grease, neatly tucked away in the passenger door.]
